schema: belt layout and potion thresholds by clvl
belt_rule: 4 columns. Buy highest tier whose clvl_req<=clvl at Akara/Malah/Lysander; Rejuv from Anya/Malah only if sold, else drops.

by_clvl.note: Mesh belt upgrade (4 cols x 4 rows) when Str allows

thresholds.note: rejuv threshold for hp potion cooldown is 2-3 s frames; poll at >=10 Hz

restock_rule: after each run or when any belt column < 50%: go to town, refill all columns; never start a run with <2 hp and <1 mp potion per column

mana_heavy_builds.tags: U design (W7 of docs/builds-endgame.md): the single mp column runs dry in War Cry/Blizzard packs; needs a live Hell check. V: unchanged rows above stay the default for every other build.

by_clvl.note: two mana columns from the start (small belt: 4 columns)
two mana columns; hp comes from rejuv and the merc

mana_heavy_builds.restock_rule: go to town when either mana column is below 50% (not only a hp column)
